segments.text: Here at Innovative Laser and Design, customers come to the shop and of course they want to see what we're doing,
segments.zh: 在 Innovative Laser and Design，客户会来到车间，他们当然想看看我们在做什么，

segments.text: they're interested in what we're doing, and we're glad to show them.
segments.zh: 他们对我们的工作很感兴趣，我们也很乐意展示给他们看。

segments.text: It's neat to see a laser and just say the word laser, everybody wants to come look at the laser.
segments.zh: 看激光很有意思，只要一说“激光”这个词，大家都想过来看看激光。

segments.text: They're used to being in homes or offices or businesses, and they're not used to walking out in an industrial shop.
segments.zh: 他们习惯了待在家里、办公室或商业场所，不习惯走进工业车间。

segments.text: So a lot of times when you have customers in a shop, you've got to look out for them.
segments.zh: 所以很多时候，车间里来了客户，你就得照看好他们。

segments.text: So we'll step through and start with that.
segments.zh: 所以我们会一步步来，从这一点开始。

segments.text: Laser cutters are going to use gases in the liquid form, it's over.
segments.zh: 激光切割机会使用液态的气体，就在那边。

segments.text: Here it is, it is released, you can see some condensation building up right here.
segments.zh: 就在这里，它正在释放，你们可以看到这里有一些冷凝水在积聚。

segments.text: Just before these release, it will blow gas, they're not ready.
segments.zh: 就在这些释放之前，它会喷出气体，他们没有准备。
